864.name: Dihang/Siang River

951.name: Burisuti

8607.end: The Taloje at Taloja, Navi Mumbai

8654.name: Dahisar
8654.origin: Tulsi Lake, Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Mumbai

8975.why: Mouth is at Bankot creek by Harihareshwar.

19186.end: Near Karimganj, Assam, where it splits into the Surma and Kushiyara

21587.end: Rameshwar, on the Rajasthan-Madhya Pradesh border

24333.why: Spelling corrected from the CWC dataset's (Sundarbans pass, owner's request).

26046.why: Joins the Matla near Canning; CWC names the stretch "Malta" (29679), now part of the Matla.

29483.why: Spelling corrected from the CWC dataset's (Sundarbans pass, owner's request).
